description: This file contains unit tests for the UsernamePasswordAuthProvider class in the org.eclipse.hono.service.auth.device package. It verifies the authentication logic, including success and failure scenarios, using the Vert.x framework and Mockito for mocking dependencies.

classes.name: UsernamePasswordAuthProviderTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of UsernamePasswordAuthProvider, including methods for setup, authentication success, failure cases, and dependency mocking.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes Vertx instance before all tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares mocks and the provider instance before each test run.

methods.name: testAuthenticateRequiresVertxContext
methods.description: Tests that authentication fails if not running on a Vert.x context.

methods.name: testAuthenticateSucceedsWhenRunningOnVertxContext
methods.description: Ensures authentication succeeds when on a Vert.x context with correct credentials.

methods.name: testAuthenticateFailsForWrongCredentials
methods.description: Verifies authentication failure when credentials are incorrect.

methods.name: testAuthenticateFailsIfNoSecretsAreValidAnymore
methods.description: Checks that authentication fails if stored secrets are expired or invalid.

methods.name: testAuthenticateFailsIfNoSecretsAreValidYet
methods.description: Checks that authentication fails if stored secrets are not yet valid.

methods.name: givenCredentialsOnRecord
methods.description: Helper method to set up mock responses for credentials retrieval.
